paite: Pathian aw, hon hondam in; tuite lah ka hinna pha in alutta hi.
heading: David La / Panpih Dia Ngetna
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

paite: Buannawi thukpi, siksan himhim omlouhna ah, ka tum hulhul hi; tui thukpi tui lian hon tupnate ah, ka na lutta hi.
english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

paite: Ka kikouna lam in ka bah a; ka dang akeu khinta; ka Pathian ka ngakna ah ka mit avai khinta hi.
english: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

paite: Bangmah lou a hon hote ka samzang sang in atam ua, dikloupi a hon dou a hon hihmanthat tumte mihattak ahi uhi; ka lak het louh ka pe nawn hi.
english: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

paite: Pathian aw, nang ka haidan na thei; nang lak ah ka khelhnate sel ahi kei hi.
english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

paite: Toupa aw, sepaihte' PATHIAN, nangmah ngakte keimah ziak in zahlak kei uhen; Israel' Pathian aw, nangmah zongte keimah ziak in hihzum in om kei uhen.
english: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

paite: Nangmah ziak a gensiat ka thuak ziak in, zumna in ka mai akhuh khinta hi.
english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

paite: Ka unaute lak ah mikhual ka na hita a, ka nu naute lak ah theih ngei louh mi ka na hita hi.
english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

paite: Na inn a ka phatuamngaihna in hon negai a; nangmah gensete gensiatnate ka tung ah akibung hi.
english: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

paite: Ka kah a, an ngawl kawm a ka hinna ka sawileh, huai gensiat a ka omna phet ahi.
english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

paite: Ka puansilh a sai-ip ka zatleh, amaute a dia hoih lou lam a gentehna ka na hi zel.
english: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

paite: Kulh kong a tute'n ka tungthu agen ua; zukhamhatte lasak ka hita hi.
english: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, ke'n zaw, hun kipahhuai ah ahi ka thum; Pathian aw, na zahngaihna thupi ziak in na hotdamna thupitak in hon dawng in.
english: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

paite: Buannawi a kipan hon humbit inla, hon tumsak mahmah ke'n; hon hote lak ah leh tui thukpi a kipan humbit in hon omsak in.
english: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

paite: Tui lian in hon tummang kei henla, tui thukpi in leng hon valh kei hen, kokhuk in leng akam chihkhum kei hen.
english: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon dawng in; na zahngaihna ahoih ngal a; na zahngaihna thupidan bang zel in kei lam hong nga in.
english: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

paite: Na sikha lak ah na mai sel ke'n; ka mangbang ngal a; hon dawng meng in.
english: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

paite: Ka hinna hon naih in, tan inla; hon doute ziak in hon humbit in.
english: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

paite: Nang mi hon gensiatnate, ka zahlaknate, ka zumnate na thei hi; hon doute na ma ah a-om vek uhi.
english: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

paite: Mi hon gensiatna in ka khasia a; nakpitak in ka lungkham behlap hi; huchi in hon hehpih ding ka zong a, himahleh kuamah a-om kei ua; hon khamuan ding ka zong nawn a, kuamah ka mu sam kei.
english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

paite: Ka an ding in banghiam thil kha ahon piak behlap ua; ka dangtak in uain thuk dawn ding in hon pia uhi.
english: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

paite: Ama ua adohkan uh thang hi henla; khamuangtak a a-om lai un pial suak hen.
english: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

paite: Amitte uh, amuh theihlouhna ding un, hihmial in om hen; akawngbomte uh kivuangsak gige in.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

paite: Na lungkim louh mahmahna atung uah sungbua inla, na heh thangpaihna in amaute man hen.
english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

paite: A-omna uh gam henla; apuanin uah kuamah om kei hen.
english: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

paite: Na satpa asawi ua, na sukliamte lungkhamna leng agen ngal nak uhi.
english: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

paite: Athulimlouhna uah thulimlouhna behlap inla; amau na diktatna ah lut kei uhen.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

paite: Amin uh hinna bu a pan nulmang in om uhen, midiktat lak ah gelh hi kei uhen.
english: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

paite: Himahleh kei gentheitak leh lungkhamtak ka hi a; Pathian aw, na hotdamna in mun sang ah hon koih in.
english: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

paite: Pathian min la in ka phat ding a, kipahthu gen in amah ka pahtawi ding hi.
english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

paite: Huchibang in bawngtal hiam, kii leh chinnei bawngtal hiam, sang in TOUPA akipaksak zaw ding hi.
english: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

paite: Thunuailutte'n huai mu in akipak uhi; nou Pathian zongte aw, na lungtang uh hing in om hen.
english: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

paite: TOUPA'N tasamte ngaikhia in, ahentate amusit ngal kei a.
english: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

paite: Lei leh van in amah phat hen, tuipite leh asung ua thil tang thei peuhmahte toh.
english: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

paite: Pathian in Zion honkhia in, Judah khuate asiam dek ngal a; huchi in huai ah a-om ding ua, neih toh athuah ding uh.
english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

paite: Asikhate suante'n gou aluah ding ua; amin itte asung ah a-om ding uhi.
english: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
